SELECT b.bseqid, p.pname, pc.price, pm.paymet, pm.pdate, pc.quan, pc.color
FROM DBUY b JOIN DCUSTOMER m ON b.user_id = m.user_id JOIN DPURCHASE pc ON b.bseqid = pc.bseqid JOIN DPROD p ON pc.rseqid = p.rseqid JOIN DPAYMENT pm ON b.bseqid = pm.bseqid WHERE m.user_id = 1

SELECT b.bseqid, m.name as username, pc.price, pm.paymet as paymet, p.pname, p.color as pcolor FROM DBUY b JOIN DCUSTOMER m ON b.user_id = m.user_id JOIN DPURCHASE pc ON b.bseqid = pc.bseqid JOIN DPROD p ON pc.rseqid = p.rseqid JOIN DPAYMENT pm ON b.bseqid = pm.bseqid WHERE b.BSEQID = #{BSEQID}

SELECT b.bseqid, m.name AS username, SUM(pc.price) AS total_price, pm.paymet AS paymet, LISTAGG(p.pname, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.pname) AS product_names, LISTAGG(p.color, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.color) AS product_colors FROM DBUY b JOIN DCUSTOMER m ON b.user_id = m.user_id JOIN DPURCHASE pc ON b.bseqid = pc.bseqid JOIN DPROD p ON pc.rseqid = p.rseqid JOIN DPAYMENT pm ON b.bseqid = pm.bseqid WHERE b.bseqid = #{BSEQID} GROUP BY b.bseqid, m.name, pm.paymet
